findings.title: Amount Claimed Mismatch

findings.title: Pharmacy Bill Date Outside Hospital Stay Window
findings.detail: The pharmacy bill is dated during the hospital stay, but the pharmacy is located in Bengaluru while the hospital is in Noida, requiring review for an in-patient purchase.
